note: USFS Custer Gallatin NF campground (Yellowstone Ranger District) on the Boulder River, ~25 mi S of Big Timber then ~8 mi S on the Main Boulder Road (CR-212). Pack-in/pack-out. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated May 2026): confirmed free, 5 sites, 32-ft limit, vault toilet, no potable water; added year-round (weather permitting; snow limits fall/winter access), no trash/firewood.
